meta.name: Moonbug Kids
meta.description:
Laugh, learn and grow with Moonbug Kids. Shows for preschoolers and families featuring their favourite characters. Great stories and music, encouraging kids to be curious and creative.

Shows: The Melon Patch, T-Rex Ranch, Little Baby Bum: Nursery Rhyme Friends, Little Angel: Nursery Rhymes and Songs for Children, Cocomelon
Available on: The Roku Channel
